pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into positions within 300 seconds of a prior stop-out or during expanding volatility bands.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe volume delta confirmation and a minimum 3:1 reward-to-risk boundary before order submission.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit lock-in once floating profit reaches $15.00, prohibiting any reversion into a negative outcome.
